question: Are there perpetuals or derivatives DEXes on Stellar yet?

golden.answer:
Perpetuals on Stellar are **emerging, with one open mainnet venue**. As of **2026-10-15**, Zenex (Zenith Protocols, formerly Hermes) runs a live Stellar mainnet perp DEX: its operator deployments page lists an active XLM-USD market, and the market contract shows on-chain fills. Noether has deployed mainnet contracts in a paused, guarded mode and says trading opens after its independent audit; its public testnet stays live. Stellars Finance may be cited as a dated directory/SCF entrant; no mainnet trading evidence was found.

No other open mainnet perp DEX was found in the operator pages, on-chain reads, Raven directories, and web sweeps checked on 2026-10-15. That is a source-relative snapshot, not proof that none exists or will launch. Re-check before answering. Do not mix leveraged spot/lending-loop products into the perp roster without explaining the different primitive.
keyFacts: Names Zenex as a live Stellar mainnet perpetual futures exchange.
Names at least one perp entrant that is not yet open on mainnet.
Treats the category as emerging rather than whitespace.
avoid: Do NOT describe Zenex as testnet-only or pre-release; it runs a live mainnet market.
Do NOT call a named entrant mainnet-live without current deployment evidence.
Do NOT claim Stellar has no mainnet perp DEX or that nobody is building perps on Stellar.
Do NOT conflate leveraged spot/lending loops with perpetual futures.
golden.notes:
EMERGING category with one open mainnet venue (corrected vs Phase-1 'whitespace' and vs the 2026-07-10/2026-08-14 'no confirmed mainnet perp DEX' snapshot). As of 2026-10-15: Zenex/formerly-Hermes (Zenith Protocols, SCF-funded) is live on Stellar mainnet — operator deployments page lists an active XLM-USD market (core contracts deployed 2026-09-29) and a public mainnet RPC read shows fills and liquidations. Noether (SCF-funded; demoed 2026-04-16 SDF meeting) deployed mainnet contracts on 2026-10-03 in guarded mode: the market is paused (get_pause_state mode 1), the vault holds no funds, and trading opens after the independent audit; its docs intro still says 'Mainnet is planned but not live', which agrees that trading is not open. Stellars Finance (SCF perps grant): Scout records testnet contracts and empty mainnet addresses (human-verified 2026-08-28); no mainnet trading evidence found. Turbolong is one-click leveraged SPOT (Blend recursive lending loops, no funding rates), NOT a perp. DefiLlama's Stellar 'Derivatives' row Normal is a synthetic-asset/index protocol with $0 Stellar TVL, not a perp DEX; Sushi Stellar is listed as a DEX, not perps.
Grader cautions: calling Zenex 'the first on-chain perps venue on Stellar' is acceptable when attributed (Lumenloop's 2026-10-09 roundup; Zenith Protocols' X bio) but is not required. Saying Noether has mainnet contracts is correct only if the answer also says trading is not open; calling Noether open for mainnet trading is wrong while its market stays paused. An answer that quotes an older Scout Zenex description saying testnet is repeating a stale source (sls-091, fixed upstream).
Also good if the answer: Distinguishes true perp DEXes from leveraged-spot products — e.g. Turbolong is one-click leveraged SPOT via Blend lending loops (no funding rates), NOT a perpetual-futures DEX.
Golden cites: Operator deployment pages or on-chain reads for mainnet status; Scout directory / SDF developer-meeting demo for the named entrants.
Corrected 2026-10-15. Grade dated source-universe honesty, not a permanent roster or a permanent single-venue claim.
